dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O'-shaped structures on the mid-dorsal region exhibit diffuse edge perimeters with a low-frequency gradient from the dark outer fur to the lighter internal patch.
